modules.name: Public pool smoke
modules.description: Verify public Stratum reachability and stable healthy mining with cleanup.

options.label: Minimum hashrate (GH/s)
options.description: Lowest healthy observed hashrate.

options.label: Maximum work age (seconds)
options.description: Oldest work accepted as healthy.

options.label: Readiness timeout (seconds)
options.description: Maximum wait for stable healthy mining.

options.label: Stable samples
options.description: Consecutive healthy observations required.

options.label: Minimum job notifications
options.description: Minimum mining.notify messages required from the probe.

options.label: Probe timeout (seconds)
options.description: Maximum independent Stratum probe duration.

options.label: Require an accepted share
options.description: Wait for an accepted device share after stable mining.

options.label: Accepted-share timeout (seconds)
options.description: Maximum wait when an accepted share is required.

modules.name: Stratum V1 regression
modules.description: Exercise ordered Stratum V1 negotiation, jobs, shares, reconnects, and cleanup.

options.label: Initial share difficulty
options.description: Difficulty used for the first deterministic job.

options.label: Changed difficulty
options.description: Different difficulty used for change handling.

options.label: Handshake timeout (seconds)
options.description: Maximum wait for negotiation and authorization.

options.label: Share timeout (seconds)
options.description: Maximum wait for a deterministic share submission.

options.label: Acceptance timeout (seconds)
options.description: Maximum wait for accepted-share state propagation.

options.label: Reconnect timeout (seconds)
options.description: Maximum wait for the miner to reconnect.

options.label: Invalid-submit observation window (seconds)
options.description: Observation window for rejected malformed work.

options.label: Extranonce2 bytes
options.description: Negotiated extranonce2 byte length.

options.label: Maximum timestamp rolling (seconds)
options.description: Allowed forward share timestamp offset; zero requires the exact job timestamp.

options.label: Healthy reconnect cycles
options.description: Successful reconnect and mining cycles in the opt-in regression.

options.label: Job burst count
options.description: Number of jobs in the opt-in final clean-job ownership regression.

options.description: Hold both controlled endpoints unavailable before restoring one.
